dct_description_sm: Contained within the Federal Elections, 1968 to 2001, Atlas of Canada series, is a map that shows the results of the federal election on June 25th, 1968. There is a large-scale map of Canada surrounded by inset maps of urban areas. There are 11 insets, none of which has a scale attributed to it. The map uses colour to show the winning party in each electoral district. There are two tables listing the districts. One just gives their numbers, while the other shows the name of the candidate elected.
